<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1383" height="679" viewBox="0 0 1383 679" font-family="Inter, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <title>cpu_req_reg block diagram</title>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M2 1L8 5L2 9" fill="none" stroke="#9a9a9a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <rect width="1383" height="679" fill="#141414"/>

  <!-- clk / rst_n -->
  <text x="648" y="43" fill="#d0d0d0" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">clk</text>
  <line x1="648" y1="65" x2="648" y2="96" stroke="#9a9a9a" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <text x="768" y="43" fill="#d0d0d0" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">rst_n</text>
  <line x1="768" y1="65" x2="768" y2="96" stroke="#9a9a9a" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

  <!-- Module container -->
  <rect x="498" y="100" width="420" height="570" rx="30" fill="none" stroke="#6b6b6b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>
  <text x="708" y="129" fill="#ffffff" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">cpu_req_reg</text>
  <text x="708" y="160" fill="#d0d0d0" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">loads when stall_cpu = 0</text>

  <!-- Column headers -->
  <text x="333" y="165" fill="#c8c8c0" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">CPU side</text>
  <text x="1091" y="165" fill="#c8c8c0" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">Cache side</text>

  <!-- CPU side (green) -->
  <g>
    <rect x="228" y="193" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#085041" stroke="#1D9E75"/>
    <text x="333" y="218" fill="#9FE1CB" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">cpu_valid</text>
    <text x="333" y="244" fill="#5DCAA5" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">in, 1 bit</text>

    <rect x="228" y="280" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#085041" stroke="#1D9E75"/>
    <text x="333" y="305" fill="#9FE1CB" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">cpu_addr</text>
    <text x="333" y="331" fill="#5DCAA5" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">in, 32 bits</text>

    <rect x="228" y="367" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#085041" stroke="#1D9E75"/>
    <text x="333" y="392" fill="#9FE1CB" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">cpu_wdata</text>
    <text x="333" y="418" fill="#5DCAA5" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">in, 32 bits</text>

    <rect x="228" y="454" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#085041" stroke="#1D9E75"/>
    <text x="333" y="479" fill="#9FE1CB" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">cpu_we</text>
    <text x="333" y="505" fill="#5DCAA5" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">in, 1 bit</text>

    <rect x="228" y="559" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#085041" stroke="#1D9E75"/>
    <text x="333" y="584" fill="#9FE1CB" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">stall_cpu</text>
    <text x="333" y="610" fill="#5DCAA5" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">out, 1 bit</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Internal registers (purple) -->
  <g>
    <rect x="543" y="193" width="330" height="69" rx="10" fill="#3C3489" stroke="#7F77DD"/>
    <text x="708" y="218" fill="#CECBF6" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">req_valid</text>
    <text x="708" y="244" fill="#AFA9EC" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">1 bit</text>

    <rect x="543" y="280" width="330" height="69" rx="10" fill="#3C3489" stroke="#7F77DD"/>
    <text x="708" y="305" fill="#CECBF6" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">req_addr</text>
    <text x="708" y="331" fill="#AFA9EC" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">32 bits</text>

    <rect x="543" y="367" width="330" height="69" rx="10" fill="#3C3489" stroke="#7F77DD"/>
    <text x="708" y="392" fill="#CECBF6" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">req_wdata</text>
    <text x="708" y="418" fill="#AFA9EC" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">32 bits</text>

    <rect x="543" y="454" width="330" height="69" rx="10" fill="#3C3489" stroke="#7F77DD"/>
    <text x="708" y="479" fill="#CECBF6" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">req_we</text>
    <text x="708" y="505" fill="#AFA9EC" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">1 bit</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Stall logic (gray) -->
  <rect x="543" y="559" width="330" height="84" rx="10" fill="#444441" stroke="#888780"/>
  <text x="708" y="587" fill="#D3D1C7" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">Stall logic</text>
  <text x="708" y="617" fill="#B4B2A9" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">req_valid &amp; ~ready</text>
  <line x1="708" y1="524" x2="708" y2="558" stroke="#6b6b6b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>

  <!-- Cache side (coral) -->
  <g>
    <rect x="978" y="193" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#712B13" stroke="#D85A30"/>
    <text x="1083" y="218" fill="#F5C4B3" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">req_valid</text>
    <text x="1083" y="244" fill="#F0997B" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">out, 1 bit</text>

    <rect x="978" y="280" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#712B13" stroke="#D85A30"/>
    <text x="1083" y="305" fill="#F5C4B3" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">req_addr</text>
    <text x="1083" y="331" fill="#F0997B" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">out, 32 bits</text>

    <rect x="978" y="367" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#712B13" stroke="#D85A30"/>
    <text x="1083" y="392" fill="#F5C4B3" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">req_wdata</text>
    <text x="1083" y="418" fill="#F0997B" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">out, 32 bits</text>

    <rect x="978" y="454" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#712B13" stroke="#D85A30"/>
    <text x="1083" y="479" fill="#F5C4B3" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">req_we</text>
    <text x="1083" y="505" fill="#F0997B" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">out, 1 bit</text>

    <rect x="978" y="559" width="210" height="69" rx="10" fill="#712B13" stroke="#D85A30"/>
    <text x="1083" y="584" fill="#F5C4B3" font-size="21" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">ready</text>
    <text x="1083" y="610" fill="#F0997B" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">in, 1 bit</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrows: CPU -> registers -->
  <g stroke="#9a9a9a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrow)">
    <line x1="441" y1="228" x2="540" y2="228" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="441" y1="315" x2="540" y2="315" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="441" y1="402" x2="540" y2="402" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="441" y1="489" x2="540" y2="489" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <!-- registers -> cache -->
    <line x1="876" y1="228" x2="975" y2="228" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="876" y1="315" x2="975" y2="315" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="876" y1="402" x2="975" y2="402" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="876" y1="489" x2="975" y2="489" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <!-- stall logic row -->
    <line x1="540" y1="601" x2="441" y2="601" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="975" y1="601" x2="876" y2="601" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  </g>
</svg>
